scope: Theorem 4.1 (Approximation by product cells) of the manuscript “Finite cylinder approximation of ruled sets” (preprints/Finite-cylinder-approximation-of-ruled-sets-September-27-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 100 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 06959ab19716522a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let h, M > 0, let D ⊂ R2 be compact with |∂D| = 0, and let V be C1 on an open neighborhood of D. Suppose that DV (p) has eigenvalues λp, −λp, where 0 < Mλp < 1 for every p ∈ D. For every e > 0, the set Sh(D, V, M) = {(x, p1 + xV1(p), h(p2 + xV2(p))) : p ∈ D, |x| ≤ M} has a finite cylinder cover with bounded open measurable perpendicular bases whose total area is at most h ∫ D Jh(V (p)) dp + e, Jh(w) = (1 + w2 1 + h2 w2 2)−1/2 .
